Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：在古代，use the standard time expression for a historical setting; the phrase with “古代时候” is not natural. [rule: time_expression]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，this refers to a concrete group of people in the story, so use the plural noun rather than the generic noun. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他们：删除，after “人们不知道,” the possessor is already clear, so the pronoun is redundant. [rule: redundancy_delete]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 试一试很多种植物：尝试各种植物，“试一试” describes a brief trial of one action, while “尝试各种植物” naturally expresses testing a range of plants. [rule: word_choice]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么植物是安全什么是危险：什么植物是安全的，什么植物是危险的，when an adjective follows “是” in this structure, use “的”; repeating “什么植物” also makes the two categories parallel and clear. [rule: none]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，this is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than assuming the reader already knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，this is the last action in a completed series of actions, so it takes “了”; earlier verbs in the series do not need it. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “古代时候” lacks the required time-expression structure, and “在古代” is a correct replacement.
This refers to the people in the story, so the teacher's rule requires “人们” rather than generic “人”.
After “人们不知道,” repeating “他们” for the same referent is unnecessary; the subject can be omitted.
“试一试很多种植物” is acceptable wording for trying many kinds of plants, even though the proposed wording is also natural.
The adjectives after “是” need “的” here, and the revised parallel phrasing is grammatical.
神农 is first introduced here, so the teacher requires a fuller introductory noun phrase.
The final action in this completed action sequence should take “了,” so “告诉了” correctly fixes the aspect.
